title: santolina pinnata subsp. neapolitana
intro: Santolina pinnata subsp. neapolitana, commonly known as 'Spanish Lavender' or 'Neapolitan Lavender', is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Santolina pinnata subsp. neapolitana include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, making it useful for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
